name: chrome-layout
description: The chrome bar fits in its view: the toolbar is not cut off, and the security indicator says what the page really is.

steps.expression: const bar = document.querySelector('.toolbar').getBoundingClientRect(); return JSON.stringify({ bottom: Math.round(bar.bottom), view: window.innerHeight });
steps.why: the toolbar is measured against the view
the whole toolbar is inside the chrome view
the chrome page is not taller than the view that holds it
the start page is a local page, and the indicator says so

steps.expression: const sec = document.getElementById('sec'); return sec.title === sec.getAttribute('aria-label') && sec.title !== 'Secure connection';
steps.why: the indicator does not claim a secure connection for a local page
